sprint: Story Reel — page-turn transitions between scenes, plus a real fix for an empty reel when no page carries narration. Scenes no longer hard-cut: a storybook leaf sweeps right-to-left off the spine, bowing as it goes, darkening toward the fold, catching light along its curved free edge, and casting a shadow onto the page it uncovers. The turn is a 2D illusion — canvas 2D has no perspective — sold entirely by the light rather than by geometry. Narration and hold time begin only once the turn onto a page has finished, so a clip is never spoken over a half-turned page and no page loses screen time to the transition.
task: js/reelComposer.js: new paintPageTurn(g,from,to,raw,W,H) (exported, pure, so it is measurable) eases progress, draws the incoming page full-frame, then compresses the outgoing leaf into [0,foldX] as 48 vertical strips each 1px wider than its slot (kills seams) with a sine bulge so the free edge bows; a gradient darkens the leaf toward the spine, brightens it near the fold, and a separate gradient casts the leaf's shadow past the fold. The rAF draw loop now owns turn progress, read from the same clock the sequencer's timer uses, so the two can never disagree about what is on screen; nextPage() starts the turn and defers settlePage() until it completes. js/storyDestinations.js: REEL_FORMATS declares transition:'page-turn' and finish() passes it through — a format opting out with 'none' still hard-cuts. ALSO FIXED (a real defect that shipped with Story Reel and was found by this feature's own verification, not caused by it): createMediaStreamDestination()'s audio track reports readyState 'live' even when nothing is ever connected to it, but delivers no samples — the muxer waits for audio that never arrives and finishes with one empty chunk, so a reel where no page carries voice composed to a 0-byte file. The destination is now fed real silence (ConstantSourceNode at offset 0, fallback a looping silent buffer) for the whole recording, stopped on both onstop and onerror. Verified: the same silent-pages reel composes to 0 bytes before the fix and 64,739 bytes after.
